title: Office English in Action
description: Master the professional English used in modern workplaces: business meetings, email writing, presentations, negotiations, and office small talk. Aimed at B2 learners who work or plan to work in English-speaking professional environments.

The register you choose depends on your relationship with the recipient and the purpose of the email."}},{"id":"eD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Email Structure","level":3}},{"id":"eG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Subject line: clear and specific (e.g. 'Meeting request – 15 May')","Salutation: Dear Mr/Ms [Surname] (formal) / Hi [Name] (semi-formal)","Opening line: context or reason for writing","Main body: organised paragraphs","Closing: request/action","Sign-off: Yours sincerely (formal) / Kind regards / Best wishes"]}},{"id":"eJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Useful Phrases","level":3}},{"id":"eM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I am writing to enquire about...","Further to our conversation...","I am pleased to inform you that...","I would be grateful if you could...","Please find attached...","I look forward to hearing from you."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text:
Dear Ms Johnson,

I ___ writing to enquire about the position advertised on your website. ___ to your job listing, I believe my experience in project management makes me a strong candidate. I would be ___ if you could send me further information.

I look forward ___ hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
A. Smith

options: Excuse me, could I just come in here?

content.content: {"time":1700080003000,"blocks":[{"id":"prA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A well-structured presentation is easier to follow and more persuasive. Use signpost language to guide your audience through the content."}},{"id":"prD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Signpost Phrases","level":3}},{"id":"prG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Opening: Good morning everyone. Today I'd like to present... / I'm going to talk about...","Sequencing: First... / Moving on to... / This brings me to...","Referring to visuals: As you can see from this slide... / The graph shows...","Concluding: To sum up... / In conclusion... / I'd like to leave you with the thought that...","Questions: I'd be happy to take any questions now."]}},{"id":"prJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Delivery tip: Speak slowly and clearly. Pause after key points. Make eye contact. Don't read from your slides."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Good morning, everyone. Today I'd like ___ talk about our Q3 sales results. First, let's look at the overall figures. ___ you can see from this slide, sales increased by 12%. Moving ___ to regional data, the biggest growth was in the eastern market. To ___ up, we exceeded our targets by a significant margin.

content.text: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Sarah from the marketing department. What line of work are you in? Oh, that's really interesting! How long have you been with the company?

questions.text: Which question is a natural networking opener?
options: What line of work are you in?
